Riedel Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Read more George A. Riedel is the Henry B. Arthur Fellow and Senior Lecturer in the General Management Unit, where he currently teaches RC Marketing and acts as a Section Chair in the Required Curriculum (RC). He has also taught The Entrepreneurial Manager (TEM), TOM (Technology and Operations Management) and LCA (Leadership and Corporate Accountability), each for several years in the RC.
